notes.notes:

The game will have a 15% discount for 1 week. The game is also part of a lot of bundles. This will make the game even cheaper if you own some of the games inside these bundles.

notes.title: Cat Search in Medieval Times is out!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2386330/Cat_Search_in_Medieval_Times/

My first hidden object game is finally out! I had a lot of fun making this game and working with a talented artist. The game is a short but pleasant experience!

If you decide to buy my game, I would like to hear from some of you about what you would like to see from my next games. I'm planing on making a series of "Cat Search" games where each game is set in a different time period. You could also tell me what you enjoyed and disliked about this game so that I can improve the next games! You could either tell me below this post or join my discord server. https://discord.gg/FDuQTmWDxA


[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43674917/1966d19f2a5178e641ae1d73aa0aba3c20f4b85e.png[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43674917/da9c1efda5a4bd52366534d21709f3ac7c64ddb2.png[/img]

Thanks to everyone that supports me by buying this game! :)
